description: How to pay or charge privately over MPP (the Machine Payments Protocol, HTTP 402) with the gloam method from @gloamtrade/mppx-gloam, with code. A charge settles as a private transfer in a Gloam vault: the chain sees no amount, asset, payer or payee.

network.description: Gloam network: "robinhood-mainnet" (Robinhood Chain mainnet: USDG and GLOAM), "tempo-mainnet" (Tempo mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0, OUSD), "base-mainnet" (Base mainnet: USDC, EURC, USDT, ETH), "ethereum-mainnet" (Ethereum mainnet: USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC, ETH), or a testnet: "tempo" (Tempo Moderato), "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain testnet), "base" (Base Sepolia) or "ethereum" (Ethereum Sepolia).

role.description: "charge" to get paid for an API or tool, "pay" for an agent or app paying one, "both" for both.

name: gloam_mpp_how_to
title: Private payments over MPP
